facts.text: The Del has just completed a six-year revitalization.
facts.excerpt: fresh from a six-year revitalization

facts.text: Hotel del Coronado is a 28-acre beachfront destination.
facts.excerpt: Hotel del Coronado is a 28‑acre beachfront destination

facts.text: Rooms and suites are spread across three neighborhoods: the Victorian, the Cabanas and the Views.
facts.excerpt: rooms and suites available in three distinct neighborhoods: the iconic Victorian, the lively Cabanas, and the contemporary Views

facts.text: The Victorian is the original beachfront hotel, established in 1888.
facts.excerpt: The Victorian is the original, iconic beachfront hotel established in 1888

facts.text: The Victorian is a restored National Historic Landmark.
facts.excerpt: Take a journey through time in this lovingly restored National Historic Landmark.

facts.text: In the Victorian, no two rooms are alike.
facts.excerpt: no two rooms are alike, and all are full of character.

facts.text: Victorian rooms have a private bathroom with walk-in shower and Victorian-era interior design.
facts.excerpt: Inside, enjoy a private bathroom with walk-in shower and an interior design that celebrates the beauty of the Victorian era.

facts.text: The Cabanas sits at the heart of the resort with a central pool, beachfront access and fireside terraces.
facts.excerpt: The Cabanas places you at the heart of the resort, with a vibrant central pool, coveted beachfront access, and fireside terraces

facts.text: Cabanas guests choose between a beachside room with a terrace and fire pit or a poolside room that serves as a private cabana.
facts.excerpt: Choose between a beachside room with a terrace and fire pit or a poolside room that serves as your private cabana

facts.text: The Views offers rooms and suites with front-row access to the Pacific.
facts.excerpt: The Views offers rooms and suites with front-row access to the Pacific

facts.text: Club Access rooms include daily breakfast, beach chairs and umbrella, seasonal Beach Club access and curated afternoon bites.
facts.excerpt: this room includes exclusive Club Access with daily breakfast, beach chairs and umbrella, seasonal Beach Club access, curated afternoon bites, and more.

facts.text: Booking a massage, facial or body treatment includes access to the spa's relaxation lounges, spa terrace and ocean-view spa pool.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy exclusive access to our relaxation lounges, spa terrace, and ocean-view spa pool when you reserve a massage, facial, or body treatment.

facts.text: Spa treatments blend traditional wellness practices with modern techniques using natural ingredients from the land and sea.
facts.excerpt: treatments that blend traditional wellness practices with modern spa techniques using natural ingredients derived from the land and sea

facts.text: The outdoor co-ed spa terrace has a vanishing-edge pool.
facts.excerpt: bring a bathing suit to enjoy the vanishing-edge pool on the outdoor co-ed spa terrace

facts.text: Experiences include private beach bonfires with s'mores, pool cabanas and surf lessons.
facts.excerpt: From private beach bonfires with s’mores to plush pool cabanas and surf lessons

facts.text: Some Like It Hot was filmed at Hotel del Coronado in 1958.
facts.excerpt: 1958 - Some Like it Hot filmed at Hotel del Coronado

facts.text: Nobu Del Coronado has indoor and al fresco dining with a covered patio, pagoda bar and dedicated sushi bar.
facts.excerpt: Nobu Del Coronado features indoor and al fresco dining with an outdoor covered patio, pagoda bar, and dedicated sushi bar.

facts.text: Veranda is an al fresco restaurant with ocean views.
facts.excerpt: A timeless al fresco dining experience with spectacular ocean views

facts.text: Parents can visit the spa while children attend the Ocean Explorers Kids Club or private childcare.
facts.excerpt: Make time for the Spa with Ocean Explorers Kids Club or Private Childcare.

facts.text: Spa services are open to young adults 14 and older.
facts.excerpt: Young adults 14 and older are welcome to receive spa services.

facts.text: Spa guests receive complimentary self-parking at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Spa guests receive complimentary self-parking at the hotel.

facts.text: SunLife Organics serves smoothies and bowls on the sand of Del Beach.
facts.excerpt: SunLife Organics has landed on Del Beach, with signature smoothies and bowls served on the sand.

facts.text: The Del calls itself the birthplace of the American beach vacation.
facts.excerpt: Hotel del Coronado has stood as the birthplace of the American beach vacation
